svg.title: Jev's average percentage for each topic I counted as yes
svg.desc: Horizontal bars, one per topic, each topic 40 messages, with a dashed line at 50 percent. A card payment I don't recognise, 83 percent, 36 of 40 at 50 percent or more. A direct debit I don't recognise, 82 percent, 35 of 40. A cash withdrawal I don't recognise, 80 percent, 34 of 40. My card may be compromised, 71 percent, 30 of 40. An extra charge on my statement, 36 percent, 8 of 40, drawn in orange. A transaction charged twice, 29 percent, 4 of 40, drawn in orange. The first four sit well above 50 percent; the last two sit below it.
